# Document Control
SOP-LAB-001 Rev 2
Page 1 of 2
Effective Date: 2026-01-01

# Purpose
This SOP describes electronic record controls for the laboratory.

# Electronic records
1. The laboratory uses a closed electronic record system.
2. Access to the system is limited to authorized personnel.
3. Electronic signatures are linked to their records.
4. Electronic records may be deleted at any time without an audit trail.

# Training
5. Personnel complete training before using the system.
